name: Nestlé Health Science - Eau Claire WI

fieldNotes.locationResolution: Roster address (3185 Galloway St) and coordinates (44.8212, -91.4667) were approximate / RANGE_INTERPOLATED. Web research confirmed the actual plant address as 1200 Nestlé Ave, Eau Claire WI 54703. Satellite at 44.8321,-91.5260 showed the large NW-SE-oriented manufacturing complex; locked center 44.8315,-91.5253. Roster point was ~6 km off.
fieldNotes.truckGate: Street View (2023-07 and 2024-08) of the NW driveway off the property frontage road shows a controlled checkpoint: a guard booth with canopy in the driveway throat plus perimeter fencing (decorative brick wall + black metal fence) running the property line.
fieldNotes.guardShack: Small canopied booth structure visible in Street View at the entrance throat, separate from the main building, ~1-2 vehicle footprint beside the inbound lane.
fieldNotes.fastLaneOpportunity: Wide paved entrance apron and a large interior paved yard immediately inside the gate give room to add an express bypass lane.
fieldNotes.drivewayLong: Gate-to-dock approach crosses a large open paved yard (NW staging area) that can hold 3+ trucks before reaching the dock faces.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: East building face shows a continuous run of ~18-20 dock doors with trailers backed in; NW corner dock apron adds ~8-12 more. Total estimated ~32, banded 25-50. Count is approximate from overhead imagery.
fieldNotes.shipRcvSeparate: Two physically distinct dock banks on different faces (long east face and NW-corner face) suggest separate shipping/receiving clusters; medium confidence.
fieldNotes.dropYard: Trailers staged on the open paved yard in the NW corner near ancillary buildings, separate from active dock positions.
fieldNotes.postGateStaging: Large open paved yard inside the gate before the dock faces serves as a holding/queue area.
fieldNotes.urbanRural: Facility sits inside the City of Eau Claire's developed fabric, surrounded by residential streets on the west and south; classified Urban.
fieldNotes.buildingCount: Main sprawling production complex plus a standalone older warehouse building to the south and ancillary sheds/storage-tank structures in the NW yard.
fieldNotes.exitLanes: Single combined entry/exit at the one gate; exit lane count inferred as 1, not separately confirmed.
fieldNotes.railServed: No rail spur visible entering the property.
